usageNotes: Use this to annotate or correct the description on an existing LXC snapshot hosted on a remote PVE node — useful after an ad-hoc snapshot is taken without a description, or when the purpose of a snapshot changes. The operation is synchronous and returns null immediately (no UPID/task to poll). Requires the Resource.Manage privilege on the remote's guest resource path.

examples.summary: Add a description to a pre-update snapshot on a remote LXC container

params.description: Snapshot taken before apt upgrade on 2026-06-29. Safe to delete after 7 days if no issues.

tips: The description field accepts free-form text and is the only editable field on a snapshot via this endpoint — snapshot name and content are immutable after creation.
Omitting the 'node' param lets PDM infer the node; supply it explicitly if the remote has multiple nodes to avoid ambiguity.
snapname must match an existing snapshot exactly (case-sensitive, same pattern as creation); verify available snapshots first via the corresponding GET endpoint.
